name: Tailscale Host Monitor
author: nixfred
description: Select nodes from your Tailscale network, track every device type, and collect deep Linux metrics over read-only SSH.

barWidget.description: Choose tailnet nodes to monitor; track Tailscale presence on every device type and deep metrics on Linux hosts.

schema.label: Initial SSH hosts (legacy)
schema.description: Used only to seed the monitored-node selection. Add and remove nodes from the Tailscale picker in the panel.

schema.label: Selected host scan
schema.description: SSH telemetry cadence for the selected host while the panel is open.

schema.label: Custom selected-host seconds
schema.description: Used only when Selected host scan is Custom.

schema.label: Tailscale discovery scan
schema.description: How often to read device presence from the local Tailscale daemon. This does not SSH into nodes.

schema.label: Custom Tailscale seconds
schema.description: Used only when Tailscale discovery scan is Custom.

schema.label: All monitored hosts scan
schema.description: Background SSH sweep for status dots and notifications across selected Linux hosts.

schema.label: Custom all-host seconds
schema.description: Used only when All monitored hosts scan is Custom.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: Width of the popup panel in layout units.

schema.label: Privacy-safe display
schema.description: Mask hostnames, Tailscale addresses, DNS names, container names, and remote error details for screenshots or screen sharing.
